name: clipboard/cut-then-paste-preserves-marks
intent: Cut removes the selected run and pasting the clipboard back at the caret restores it inline with its marks. Cut now deletes; the paste-back still lands as its own block because applyReplaceRange compiles the slice with emitBlock and mints a new node instead of rendering the leading textblock inline onto the destination line NodePathBox. Same root cause as clipboard/copy-inside-a-list-item-then-paste-into-a-paragraph.
